_comment: Curated display content for the DWCode extension catalog: one original one-line blurb and one family per catalog-eligible package. `families` is the sidebar taxonomy (ordered), `omit` lists licence-eligible packages that are deliberately NOT shown on the site and why (same reasons as FOSS_EXTENSION_REPOSITORY.md's Excluded table), `entries` must cover every row the gate reports as accept/verified after the omissions — tools/build-catalog.mjs fails the build otherwise. Blurbs are written for this project: facts only (what it is, what DWCode does with it), never text copied from an upstream listing.

omit.jlcodes.antigravity-cockpit: Licence verified MIT, but it reads a Google IDE's quotas — DWCode is not that IDE, so there is no capability to attach it to (FOSS_EXTENSION_REPOSITORY.md, Excluded).
omit.n2ns.antigravity-panel: Same as the Cockpit: Apache-2.0 upstream, service-specific to Google Antigravity.
omit.iml1s.antigravity-plus: Claims MIT on the registry, but its repository is 404 — no verifiable upstream to credit, and the same no-target problem.
omit.woozy-masta.codex-switch: MIT, but multi-account rotation has no DWCode feature to map to (Excluded, usefulness not licence).
omit.adguard.tokenguard-copilot: MIT code that only works on top of GitHub Copilot — proprietary and absent from Open VSX, so listing it would imply support DWCode does not have.
omit.statiolake.vscode-copilot-lsp: MIT, but it exists to serve GitHub Copilot — same proprietary dependency as above.
omit.allansantos-dv.copilot-delegate: MIT, but delegates to the Copilot CLI — a proprietary product DWCode does not integrate with.
